target_description: 已完成日盘收盘后，联合预测未来1–5个观测交易日内首次未来超阈值的累计概率。ATM隐波或凸性违反代理任一日最大值超过预测日前最近60个完整交易日（至少20日）95%分位即为事件；阈值在预测原点冻结。当前正常与已异常状态分开建模。所有期限共享一条离散时间风险率曲线，累计概率为1−∏(1−风险率)。这是曲面异常代理，不是持仓亏损概率或VaR。观测交易日不是官方交易所日历。
evaluation_design: Development walk-forward on previously inspected history; not an external blind test. Fixed three historical vintages, all five horizons on the same complete-five-day origins. Five predeclared shrunk candidates; no test-dependent candidate, threshold, or hyperparameter choice.

fixed_parameters.origin_eligibility: complete five-session label window for every horizon
fixed_parameters.split_purge: all splits use label_end_5 strictly before the next boundary
fixed_parameters.candidate_selection: past validation only; no fold/test-driven parameter changes
fixed_parameters.bootstrap_method: paired circular moving blocks of global observed dates; all symbols retained together

base_training.calibration: same shared hazard-logit intercept for every candidate on independent calibration block; no horizon-wise calibration
base_training.selection: per task/symbol minimum mean Brier over the complete five-horizon curve on validation only; ties prefer baseline then uniform logistic
base_training.threshold: per-task/symbol/horizon validation-only F1; baseline rates do not issue predictive alerts
base_training.censoring: exclude whole origin unless all five future sessions are complete and contiguous
base_training.preprocessing: train-only median/IQR, clipping at 8; binary indicator scale 1
base_training.quality_gate: same whole-curve missingness/dynamic RAW feature OOD fraction >.35 for all candidates; separately withhold any selected RAW feature departure from collapsed training 99% bounds (rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-8)

model.calibration: independent task affine hazard-logit plus shrunk symbol offsets; all candidates equally treated
model.blend_space: conditional hazard probabilities before survival product
model.selection: pooled per task; maximize paired validation mean Brier gain minus one nonoverlapping 10-date-block standard error; positive margin required; ties prefer baseline/smaller weight/uniform model
model.threshold: task-pooled validation F1; baseline does not issue predictive alerts

daily_session_quality.night_coverage: observed source snapshots only; may be partial

operational_gate.historical_as_of: each eligible completed forecast origin's close; age=0 by construction
operational_gate.rules: raw feature missingness >35%, insufficient history/core features, raw-feature training-range dynamic OOD >35%, selected raw training-constant feature departure, unsupported task, or incoherence suppresses all horizon alerts; baseline-selected modes emit no predictive alert
operational_gate.staleness_limitation: Historical-close replay does not measure real-time delivery delays, stale-feed outages or incomplete-session current forecasts; live stale checks remain necessary.
operational_gate.probability_coverage_definition: Includes visible historical-rate fallback curves; predictive_signal_coverage additionally requires a selected complex model. Baseline fallback emits no predictive alert.

limitations: Market-surface proxy, not portfolio loss, VaR or CVaR.
Existing history and all V2 results were inspected before V3; all intervals and walk-forward results are development evidence.

Thresholds frozen at each origin; normal-origin onset and currently-abnormal persistence are different tasks. Persistence target is any future exceedance, not uninterrupted persistence or time-to-recovery.
Positive-label origin runs are proxy episodes, not deduplicated actual event dates. No event lead-time claim is made.
Observed session calendar and >7-day gaps conservatively exclude missing data and some long holidays.
Bootstrap preserves date-level cross-symbol dependence but conditions on fitted vintages, has no multiple-comparison adjustment, and cannot prove future gains.

Candidate fallback and thresholds are selected only by preceding validation data; no test-driven fallback is applied. Validation F1 is a provisional product objective; business false-alarm and missed-event costs are not supplied.
Final artifact is exactly the latest fold vintage; no refit uses its test labels.
